C-0A.title: The Ace of Cups
C-0A.upright: Love. Joy. Spirituality. Compassion. Abundance of emotion and creativity. Beginning of new creative endeavors and relationships.
C-0A.reversed: Spiritual egotism. Suggests hindrances to spiritual growth caused by being too literal about your practice. Creative, emotional, spiritual, or physical infertility.

C-02.title: The Two of Cups
C-02.upright: Unity. Relationships. Balance. Partnership. Friendship. Cooperation. Relationship bonds and commitments that offer harmony and support.
C-02.reversed: Miscommunication. Suggests a loss of balance in relationship caused by miscommunication. Codependency.

C-03.title: The Three of Cups
C-03.upright: Celebration. Camaraderie. Joyful occurrences. Friendship and family bonds are honored and supported, particularly feminine ones. Social events and gatherings are recognized.
C-03.reversed: Overreliance on friends. Premature celebration. Distracting yourself from something you would rather not be doing or from emotional or sexual dissatisfaction. Seeking approval.

C-04.title: The Four of Cups
C-04.upright: Rest. Reflection. Boredom. Detachment. Apathy. Indicates ignored opportunities. Open doors may be overlooked while focus is diverted.
C-04.reversed: Signifies a readiness to reengage with your life and start saying yes again, even to new relationships. Dissatisfaction. Moving on.

C-05.title: The Five of Cups
C-05.upright: Grief. Sorrow. Mourning. Disappointment. Ruminating. One may be stuck on past trauma or feeling sad and regretful, while not appreciating what remains.
C-05.reversed: Pain of Five of Cups intensifies. Overwhelming loss. Recovering from grief. Can signify progress in healing from a loss. Getting support.

C-06.title: The Six of Cups
C-06.upright: Childhood comforts. Nostalgia. Reminiscing about happier times or childhood. Shows elements of joyful innocence, sharing, playful energy, childlike wonder.
C-06.reversed: Lost in nostalgia. You may see your past through rose-colored glasses at the expense of your present life. Unhappy childhood memories.

C-07.title: The Seven of Cups
C-07.upright: Fantasy. Creativity. Temptation. Dreaming without action. Being caught up in overthinking or overwhelmed by thoughts or the many options to choose from.
C-07.reversed: Delusion. Fantasy. You might be fooled by appearances, idealizing someone or something. Choosing to believe fantasy over reality. Resisting temptation.

C-08.title: The Eight of Cups
C-08.upright: Leaving. Wandering. Seeking. Walking away from what no longer serves us. Contemplation or moving on is needed. Avoidance of feeling unfulfilled may also arise.
C-08.reversed: Drifting. You may be endlessly traveling, wandering, leaving, and abandoning situations too soon. Lack of patience. Returning home from a spiritual search.

C-09.title: The Nine of Cups
C-09.upright: Hosting. Welcoming. Enjoyment. Wishes being granted. Success. Feelings of contentment or gratitude for one's blessings.
C-09.reversed: Undeserving of enjoyment. Overindulgence. Either indicates that you don't feel you deserve to enjoy yourself or that you may need to share more.

C-10.title: The Ten of Cups
C-10.upright: Family love. Togetherness. Joy. Emotional fulfillment and happiness, including in relationships. Alignment. Balance. Wholeness.
C-10.reversed: Family love. Threat to harmony. Distracted by ideals. Indicates love and togetherness, but your ideal of what family "should" look like may sidetrack you from the joy in your life.

C-J1.title: The Page of Cups
C-J1.upright: Innocent. Imaginative. Dreamer. Inspiring news. Being open to new opportunities and creativity. Spiritual or intuitive connections. Receiving messages.
C-J1.reversed: Naive. Irresponsible. Impulsive. Too immersed in emotions to notice others.

C-J2.title: The Knight of Cups
C-J2.upright: Romance. Idealism. Passion. Inspiration. Daydreaming. Fantasies. Creativity. Appreciation for the beauty of life, charm, and a leisurely pace.
C-J2.reversed: Hesitant to act or express emotions. Creative, emotional, or spiritual block due to disappointment or fear of rejection. Possessive in a relationship.

C-QU.title: The Queen of Cups
C-QU.upright: Nurturing. Healing. Compassion. Love. Empathy. The Queen is intuitive, creative, contemplative, and in charge of emotions.
C-QU.reversed: Depression. Victimhood. Draining. Reversed Queen of Cups neglects to love herself. Can be manipulative or draining.

C-KI.title: The King of Cups
C-KI.upright: Calm. Shoulder to cry on. Symbolizes mastering one's emotions and creative achievement. Compassion. Balancing emotion with logic.
C-KI.reversed: Insecurity. Shame. Hatred. Betrayal. Seeks emotional balance.

P-0A.title: The Ace of Pentacles
P-0A.upright: Perfection. Contentment. Prosperity. Abundance and security, particularly with new opportunities. Manifestation is likely with hard work and planning.
P-0A.reversed: Financial disappointment. Materialism. Can reveal an unhealthy love of money, mismanagement, wastefulness, or inflexible financial expression.

P-02.title: The Two of Pentacles
P-02.upright: Juggling. Balancing. Shows the need for balance and flexibility.
P-02.reversed: Suggests work and life imbalances, you are drained and overwhelmed, or the double life you may lead doesn't align with your values or everyone's happiness.

P-03.title: The Three of Pentacles
P-03.upright: Meaningful work. Collaboration. Renown. Signifies working with others toward a goal, the early stages of a project, or learning new skills.
P-03.reversed: Tedium and mediocrity, particularly in matters of career. Exhaustion. Burnout.

P-04.title: The Four of Pentacles
P-04.upright: Security. Miserliness. Denotes conservation or protection of assets. One may be closed off emotionally or holding tightly to energy or possessions, or strict with finances.
P-04.reversed: Financial need. Indicates a real need to pinch pennies or an extremely miserly attitude.

P-05.title: The Five of Pentacles
P-05.upright: Hardship. Community. Resilience. Speaks of feeling isolated, left out, or lacking. One may have fallen on hard times, feel they don't have enough, or lack security.
P-05.reversed: Physical or financial recovery. Denotes bouncing back from an illness or an emotional or financial loss.

P-06.title: The Six of Pentacles
P-06.upright: Generosity. Social justice. Symbolizes giving and receiving. Encouragement to share abundance, help those in need, or be willing to accept support.
P-06.reversed: Suggests you are taking someone's generosity for granted or that someone else is making light of your generosity. Take good care of your resources and appreciate what you have.

P-07.title: The Seven of Pentacles
P-07.upright: Investment. Uncertainty. Patience. Refers to holding a vision or focusing on long-term goals. Planning, perseverance, and knowing that an end goal is near.
P-07.reversed: Avoiding responsibility. Indicates that you may be refusing to look at your financial situation or you are evading a reality check about the progress of an important project.

P-08.title: The Eight of Pentacles
P-08.upright: Hard work. Concentration. Education. Training. Reveals progress and dedication to a craft. Mastering skills, studying further, and fine-tuning situations.
P-08.reversed: Unsatisfying career. You are either working too hard or not hard enough. You may feel that your work is not satisfying or right for you.

P-09.title: The Nine of Pentacles
P-09.upright: Retirement. Prosperity. Comfort. Symbolizes affluence and abundance. Financial security. Being able to provide for oneself. Decadence. Achievement.
P-09.reversed: Loneliness. Regretful. You may have focused much of your life on your career and are now experiencing regret that you did not do more to cultivate your relationships.

P-10.title: The Ten of Pentacles
P-10.upright: Generations. Community resources. Foundation. Wealth. Inheritance. Success. Accomplishment. Providing for family and prosperity.
P-10.reversed: Family conflict over finances, property, or values. Reveals imbalance, tension, or outright conflict among generations of family or community.

P-J1.title: The Page of Pentacles
P-J1.upright: Apprentice. Diligence. Awe. Good news about money. Depicts new opportunities of a material nature. Speaks to the initial planning and manifesting of ideas and projects.
P-J1.reversed: Materialistic. Wasteful. Less diligent. May bring unwelcome financial news or unhappy news about your property.

P-J2.title: The Knight of Pentacles
P-J2.upright: Provider. Responsible. Constructing. Secure. The Knight works hard, with diligence, conservation, and commitment. Stays the course.
P-J2.reversed: Inertia. Stubbornness. Too cynical and cautious to be motivated to do much of anything. Might be miserly with money. Neglects to care for people. Focuses on materialistic desires.

P-QU.title: The Queen of Pentacles
P-QU.upright: Resourceful. Pragmatic. Generous. Embodies abundance and nurturing. The Queen is practical, successful, and caring toward loved ones. Warmth. Love. Security.
P-QU.reversed: Dependent. Mismanaging. Might neglect or mismanage resources, or even find themselves in debt. Can go overboard in fulfilling their role—caring for everyone but themselves.

P-KI.title: The King of Pentacles
P-KI.upright: Provider. Established. Security. Portrays material success, leadership, and wealth. The King is prosperous, a confident provider, and represents fulfilled goals and ventures.
P-KI.reversed: Greed. Materialism. Corruption. Gambling. Reversed King of Pentacles has lost sight of the purpose of managing resources well.
